findings: As printed the proposition is false (D-11, DEC-77), now refuted with the PRINTED hypothesis AND the RULED conclusion: GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC118 (0 sorry, standard axioms) — {τ<0} ⊂ E0 is GH, Cauchy-complete in DEC-31's sense (GX.e0PastHalf_isE0CauchyComplete), has BTZ points, and NO datum of {τ<0}~ (any base point, any presentation, chartwise or not) satisfies BTZTildeData.IsBTZFutureComplete (GX.e0PastHalf_not_isBTZFutureComplete: on reg M~, r = a ∘ D with a affine; for regular x every w ≫ x is regular with r(x) ≤ r(w) ≤ r(x) − 2τ(x), so a is bounded on the open cone I+(Dx) = D(I+(x)), hence constant, while r takes the values 1 and 2). The Reg-part reading fails as well (GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC31).

The proof's l.2350 omits that Barbot's future completeness needs equality D(reg M~) = Omega+, i.e. absolute maximality (B21 Cor 2.18) and the future case; the proof cites 'Lemma 2.4' for what is B21 Lemma 2.3 (D-11 (b)).

The proof's two steps (Reg M~ future complete, l.2350; full BTZ rays, l.2352) do not by themselves give « M future complete » in DEC-118 (a)'s reading: J+ in Reg M~ is not J+ in M~. Round 2 supplies the transport of Reg M~'s causality into M~'s (GX.btzTilde_transport) and the BTZ-point charts (GX.BTZTildeData.chart_notMem_btzJReg_of_sing); what the paper's « Lemma 2.4 implies full BTZ rays » still leaves implicit is that the ray of M lifts to M~ and develops onto the whole null half-line (GX.btzTilde_null_supset).

DEC-31 on a slice of E0: the length chart system e0SliceSys of {τ=-1} is the Euclidean metric of C (GX.edist_e0SliceSys_pastSlice); the template — local chart = g • sector chart (GX.pastHalf_regChart_eventually), the sector chart along τ=const is a local isometry of |dz|^2 (GX.hasDerivAt_chartMap_slice), FTC across the zero set of z (GX.ofReal_norm_sub_le_of_zeroFree) — handles BTZ times, where IsLocLip imposes no regularity.

A level {τ=c} ∩ W is a Cauchy surface of any past/future set W of E0 in paper time by the sliceDom argument with τ in place of h (GX.e0_isCauchySurfaceOn_pastOpen), transported to an E0-manifold by isEMorphismOn_of_chartIso + isCauchySurfaceOn_image_iff.

Spacelike Lipschitz of a graph τ = G in the flat charts of Reg M: E0Surgery.isSpacelikeLipschitzAt_of_coneZeroSet with F = chartHeight G g; for constant G, fderiv_chartHeight_pos with L = 0 (spacelikeDelta 0 0 r = 1).

The BTZ half through the bridge: letI := E0Bridge.e0SingularGXStructure M; haveI := ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace E0Y M; attribute [local instance] btzE0Structure; E0Bridge.basePt x₀ makes the bridge's base point the headline's (regPtF_basePt is rfl).

One M~ datum carrying D: BTZTildeData.exists_isChartwise then E0Bridge.exists_btzTildeData_extending (d'.T' = d.T'); IsChartwise reads T' only (unfold BTZTildeData.IsChartwise; rw [hT]), so the translate is chartwise and natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base applies.

Refuting IsBTZFutureComplete on an E0-manifold: d.D on reg M~ is devOnCover ∘ regTildeHomeo (simp [devOnCover, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]); proj_regTildeHomeo identifies bases; d.proj_le + E0Bridge.e0ManifoldCausality_eq_chartedCausality gives the order of M, then E0.Le.closed; an affine map bounded on an open cone is constant (scale along rays, AffineMap.ext_on + IsOpen.affineSpan_eq_top).
PathConnectedSpace (e0RegMFlat M): pathConnectedSpace_iff_connectedSpace with ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace (Minkowski 2) — needed for Causal.UniversalCover.proj_surjective.

Transport a causality along an inclusion from an absolutely minimal one (flatCausality): Causal.Precausality.absolutelyMinimal_iff.1 flatCausality_absolutelyMinimal S hS ⊤ le_rfl gives a TransGen of relations in members of ANY open cover S, so it suffices to choose S = the opens on which the transport holds (GX.btzTilde_transport).

A regular chart of M~ into J+(Delta_0): on a ball B of radius ≤ the half-space margin around D c, w ↦ btzJ0RegInv (h • d.D w) with h the translation D c ↦ btzJ0Pt; build it on the natural topology and retopBTZ it (d.nhds_reg at regular points); the straight segment btzJSeg of the target ball is a chart link (btzJ_curveOn_seg / _seg_lt + btzJSegPt_mem_ball) (GX.btzTilde_transport_local).

Chart/BTZ-point correspondence: every chart of btzTildeDevAtlas d.D sends a BTZ point to Delta_0 (GX.BTZTildeData.chart_notMem_btzJReg_of_sing): the descent chart does (exists_mem_btzTildeDevAtlas_of_descent_val + btz_sing + btzJDev_mem_btzJReg_iff), and two charts cannot disagree since J+(Delta_0) is a Euclidean neighbourhood of no point of Delta_0 (GX.btzJplus_notMem_nhds_of_mem_btzLine). Consequence: I+(x) ⊆ reg M~ (GX.BTZTildeData.Iplus_subset_reg).

Image membership on d.Space: elements obtained from d.D '' S have the MaxBranchedCover type; use d.fromNat y and (Causal.Precausality.mem_Iplus_singleton (M := d.Space)).1 to avoid the SpreadEnd vs WithWrappedTop instance mismatch.
